svg.text: INFY 20k kata, Portfolio DB me share nahi aaye
PEHLE: do DB, ek transaction nahi
AB: har kadam ka haal likho, fail pe wahin se retry (status log)
match ke baad ulta nahi; retry dobara chala to trade_id se kuch nahi badalta
PHIR? "Portfolio DB ghanta bhar band hai. User ko bolo dobara order kare?"
user kuch nahi karta, trade khud poora
